sections.voiceover: Residents in Adigrat spotted troops advancing toward ongoing clashes. Addis Ababa invoked self-defense measures at the Security Council. Where did the Eritrean battalions deploy next?
Asmara pushed forces deep into northern Ethiopia, but Addis Ababa warned of direct conflict.
